author: OhLookItsDaOne
description: Protects a designated channel: first offense times out the user and deletes their messages, a second offense kicks them. Admin configurable.
install_msg: Cog installed. Configure it with `[p]setguardchannel`, `[p]setkickchannel` and `[p]setpunishmenttime`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog only stores offense counts in memory. No end user data is stored persistently.
